meaning:
φίλημα, -τος, τό
(φιλέω), [in LXX: Pro.27:6, Sng.1:2 (נְשִׁיקָה) * ;]
a kiss: Luk.7:45 22:48; as a token of Christian brotherhood, φ. ἅγιον, Rom.16:16, 1Co.16:20, 2Co.13:12, 1Th.5:26; φ. ἀγάπης, 1Pe.5:14 (see Lft., Notes, 90; DB, DCA, see word "Kiss").†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
Greet one another with a holy kiss.
Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
